output.summary: Arts' gap is mostly structural, not deprioritisation. SlotBook tickets (42% of Arts volume) go to the P4 best-effort queue under RR-17 (median 21 days). Removing them closes 70% of the 6-day gap. Lindqvist on-site coverage (Tuesday/Thursday only) explains most of the rest, since Education shows the same pattern. Like-for-like remote tickets match other faculties, and duplicate rates are similar. Volume is not fully explained by SlotBook. The ACK-P4 template tells requesters nothing about priority. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is unresolved: there is no record and the accounts conflict. Best next steps are to agree SlotBook support status, fix the acknowledgement and report split metrics. Putting all Arts tickets on P4 or transferring FTE is unjustified.
